symptom: A confirmed transcription stage appeared not begun after a service pause without work metadata.
root_cause: The service pause overlay replaced serverPhase and cleared work, losing the last validated server processing phase.
fix: Persist serverLastProcessingPhase independently of presentation pause; assign only known validated server phases; restore known previous snapshots; clear when allocating a new request UUID.
validation_scope: The manager tests execute actual protocol application, model accessors, atomic persistence and restore. Root runs full App E2E and status_ux executes actual UIKit renderer.
